note: ZIN-written sentence shapes with named holes ({$name}). A family row calls a frame by id and fills the holes with glossary slots or literals; a stem row fills {$label} and {$label_lc} from the key's own id and {$v1}, {$v2} with the vanilla key's variables in order. Frames hold ZIN text only. A frame is added when three keys share a shape; later family authors add frames and never change one another family uses.
